urlText: Gordon Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Platform 1 is not available
content:

From Monday 28 April until Sunday 11 May, lift upgrades will be taking place at Gordon station, closing the lift between the concourse and Platform 1. An alternative route is available along Werona Avenue, Park Avenue and Wade Lane to access the Wade Lane ramp to the concourse. 
If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9847 8458.
